verdict.rationale: Supermemory has a live, working llms.txt (probe confirms HTTP 200 with structured doc links) plus a documented remote MCP that lets agents search Supermemory documentation directly and an official skill/CLI for agent-oriented integration setup, all explicitly aimed at agents implementing integrations correctly instead of hallucinating APIs. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents actually use llms.txt successfully in practice beyond the probe check.
